text:
The world's favourite airline, going by the Skytrax World Airline Awards, is Qatar Airways, which won in 2024 and 2025, with Singapore Airlines as its usual closest rival. The note about a UK flag carrier topping every poll doesn't match what I know, since British Airways doesn't consistently lead any major global ranking. "Favourite" depends on the survey, and I can't confirm the 2026 winner.

CONFIDENCE: 62
